==Grandmaster==
Each [[Conclave order]] is led by a [[grandmaster]] who is elected by their members. {{#lst:Archive:All_Election_Results|{{{1}}}_election}} The table to the right shows the citizens who have been elected as grandmaster of the order in the years since [[Empress Britta]] died.
